'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Isaac Proctor LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Isaac Proctor]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
